title: Past simple: what happened
goal: Talk about finished events with the right past forms
intro: Use the past simple for finished actions at a finished time: yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago. Regular verbs add -ed, but the most common verbs are irregular (go → went, buy → bought). In questions and negatives, “did” carries the past, so the main verb goes back to its base form.

rules.rule: Regular: add -ed. Irregular: learn the form.
examples: We went to Goa and bought gifts.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I go to the market.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I went to the market.

ex.q: We ___ a great movie last night.
___ you finish the work on time?
She ___ me a message an hour ago.
Last year we travel to Sikkim.
ex.fixed: Last year we travelled to Sikkim.

ex.q: Did she came to the office today?
ex.fixed: Did she come to the office today?

ex.a: What did you have for dinner?

ex.q: Make it negative: “I went to the party.”
a: I didn't go to the party
I did not go to the party

talk: Tell the coach about last weekend from morning to night. Use the past in every sentence: I woke up, I went, I met, I didn’t….
